title: Chapter 7 — Semester Break
description: Home for the holidays: the street calls you "Royal Crest", Owó Ńlá wants a speech, and Mama has questions about a loan app.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Iyana-Wahala. The bus stop is exactly the same. You are not. You notice you hold your bag differently. You notice the street noticing.

beats.speaker: ada
beats.text: Look at Royal Crest! (She circles you.) New shoes. Same face. Okay, you can still enter my shop.

beats.speaker: mamaSomto
beats.text: My son! (She sees the shoes.) Where did these come from?

variants.text: My son. (She doesn't hug you first.) A man called my phone last week. QuickCash. He called me "the debtor's mother". Sit down, Somto.

options.text: Tell her everything: the birthday, the loan, the interest.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Saturday. The Honourable's "Youth Empowerment Day" at the Front Stop. Generators, a canopy, a cake in the shape of a ballot box. You are on the programme: "Vote of thanks by a beneficiary".

beats.speaker: settlement
beats.text: (handing you a printed speech) Read it. Smile. Point at the Honourable at the word "father". It's on page two.

beats.speaker: player
beats.text: The microphone smells of somebody else's breath. The street is watching.

options.text: Read it exactly. "Our father, the Honourable..."
Put the paper down. Thank Mama, the street, Garba's tea and Dr. Adébáyọ̀. Mention the Honourable once, politely.
Fake a sore throat. Let someone else read it.

beats.speaker: owoNla
beats.text: (afterwards, shaking your hand for the cameras) Good boy. Very good boy.

variants.text: (afterwards, smiling for the cameras, not with his eyes) "Garba's tea". Very creative. (He keeps shaking your hand a little too long.) Barrister will discuss creativity with you.

beats.objective: Get a tea from Mallam Garba before you go back.

beats.speaker: garba
beats.text: Royal Crest. (He pours from very high, showing off.) When you are a big man, don't forget who gave you sugar on credit.

beats.speaker: player
beats.text: There's a lecturer at school, Dr. Adébáyọ̀. He says economics happens at bus stops.

beats.speaker: garba
beats.text: (delighted) Then I am a professor of economics! Thirty years, never a degree. Tell your lecturer my tea is ₦100. Inflation.

beats.title: Semester Break
beats.summary: Home is the same; you aren't. You made a speech, or read one. The street saw which.
